lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa ||
lines.translation: Aasaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਜ ਸਾਢੇ ਤੈ ਤੈ ਧੋਤੀਆ ਤਿਹਰੇ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਤਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaj saadhe tai tai dhoteeaa tihare paain tag ||
lines.translation: They wear loin cloths, three and a half yards long, and triple-wound sacred threads.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਲੀ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਜਪਮਾਲੀਆ ਲੋਟੇ ਹਥਿ ਨਿਬਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: galee jinhaa japamaaleeaa lote hath nibag ||
lines.translation: They have rosaries around their necks, and they carry glittering jugs in their hands.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਬਾਨਾਰਸਿ ਕੇ ਠਗ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: oi har ke sa(n)t na aakheeahi baanaaras ke thag ||1||
lines.translation: They are not called Saints of the Lord - they are thugs of Benares. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਸੰਤ ਨ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਭਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aise sa(n)t na mo kau bhaavahi ||
lines.translation: Such 'saints' are not pleasing to me;

lines.gurmukhi: ਡਾਲਾ ਸਿਉ ਪੇਡਾ ਗਟਕਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: daalaa siu pedaa gatakaavahi ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: they eat the trees along with the branches. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਸਨ ਮਾਂਜਿ ਚਰਾਵਹਿ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਾਠੀ ਧੋਇ ਜਲਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: baasan maa(n)j charaavahi oopar kaathee dhoi jalaavahi ||
lines.translation: They wash their pots and pans before putting them on the stove, and they wash the wood before lighting it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਸੁਧਾ ਖੋਦਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦੁਇ ਚੂਲੑੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਮਾਣਸ ਖਾਵਹਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: basudhaa khod karahi dui choolhe saare maanas khaavahi ||2||
lines.translation: They dig up the earth and make two fireplaces, but they eat the whole person! ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਪਾਪੀ ਸਦਾ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਅਪਰਸ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: oi paapee sadaa phirahi aparaadhee mukhahu aparas kahaavahi ||
lines.translation: Those sinners continually wander in evil deeds, while they call themselves touch-nothing saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਸਗਲ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਡੁਬਾਵਹਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sadaa phirahi abhimaanee sagal kuta(n)b dubaavahi ||3||
lines.translation: They wander around forever and ever in their self-conceit, and all their families are drowned. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਤੈਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit ko laaiaa tit hee laagaa taise karam kamaavai ||
lines.translation: He is attached to that, to which the Lord has attached him, and he acts accordingly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kahu kabeer jis satigur bhetai punarap janam na aavai ||4||2||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, one who meets the True Guru, is not reincarnated again. ||4||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa ||
lines.translation: Aasaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਪਿ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ਮੇਰੋ ਕੀਨੑਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: baap dilaasaa mero keenhaa ||
lines.translation: My Father has comforted me. He has given me a cozy bed,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਦੀਨੑਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sej sukhaalee mukh a(n)mrit deenhaa ||
lines.translation: And placed His Ambrosial Nectar in my mouth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਪ ਕਉ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis baap kau kiu manahu visaaree ||
lines.translation: How could I forget that Father from my mind?

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਗਇਆ ਨ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aagai gaiaa na baajee haaree ||1||
lines.translation: When I go to the world hereafter, I shall not lose the game. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਈ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ਹਉ ਖਰਾ ਸੁਖਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: muee meree maaee hau kharaa sukhaalaa ||
lines.translation: Maya is dead, O mother, and I am very happy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਰਉ ਨਹੀ ਦਗਲੀ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: pahirau nahee dagalee lagai na paalaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I do not wear the patched coat, nor do I feel the chill. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਲਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਪੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਉ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bal tis baapai jin hau jaaiaa ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to my Father, who gave me life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚਾ ਤੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)chaa te meraa sa(n)g chukaaiaa ||
lines.translation: He put an end to my association with the five deadly sins.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਾਵਾ ਤਲਿ ਦੀਨੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch maar paavaa tal deene ||
lines.translation: I have conquered those five demons, and trampled them underfoot.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਭੀਨੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har simaran meraa man tan bheene ||2||
lines.translation: Remembering the Lord in meditation, my mind and body are drenched with His Love. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਤਾ ਹਮਾਰੋ ਵਡ ਗੋਸਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: pitaa hamaaro vad gosaaee ||
lines.translation: My Father is the Great Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਪਹਿ ਹਉ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis pitaa pahi hau kiu kar jaaee ||
lines.translation: How shall I go to that Father?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ ਤ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur mile ta maarag dikhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: When I met the True Guru, He showed me the Way.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jagat pitaa merai man bhaaiaa ||3||
lines.translation: The Father of the Universe is pleasing to my mind. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਪੂਤੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਬਾਪੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau poot teraa too(n) baap meraa ||
lines.translation: I am Your son, and You are my Father.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੈ ਠਾਹਰ ਦੁਹਾ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ekai thaahar duhaa baseraa ||
lines.translation: We both dwell in the same place.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਨਿ ਏਕੋ ਬੂਝਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahu kabeer jan eko boojhiaa ||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, the Lord's humble servant knows only the One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝਿਆ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: gur prasaad mai sabh kichh soojhiaa ||4||3||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, I have come to know everything. ||4||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa ||
lines.translation: Aasaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਤੁ ਪਤਰਿ ਭਰਿ ਉਰਕਟ ਕੁਰਕਟ ਇਕਤੁ ਪਤਰਿ ਭਰਿ ਪਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikat patar bhar urakat kurakat ikat patar bhar paanee ||
lines.translation: In one pot, they put a boiled chicken, and in the other pot, they put wine.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਿ ਪਾਸਿ ਪੰਚ ਜੋਗੀਆ ਬੈਠੇ ਬੀਚਿ ਨਕਟ ਦੇ ਰਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aas paas pa(n)ch jogeeaa baithe beech nakat de raanee ||1||
lines.translation: The five Yogis of the Tantric ritual sit there, and in their midst sits the noseless one, the shameless queen. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਕਟੀ ਕੋ ਠਨਗਨੁ ਬਾਡਾ ਡੂੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: nakatee ko thanagan baadaa doo(n) ||
lines.translation: The bell of the shameless queen, Maya, rings in both worlds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਨਹਿ ਬਿਬੇਕੀ ਕਾਟੀ ਤੂੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kinahi bibekee kaatee too(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Some rare person of discriminating wisdom has cut off your nose. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਕਟੀ ਕਾ ਵਾਸਾ ਸਗਲ ਮਾਰਿ ਅਉਹੇਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagal maahi nakatee kaa vaasaa sagal maar auheree ||
lines.translation: Within all dwells the noseless Maya, who kills all, and destroys them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲਿਆ ਕੀ ਹਉ ਬਹਿਨ ਭਾਨਜੀ ਜਿਨਹਿ ਬਰੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਚੇਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sagaliaa kee hau bahin bhaanajee jinahi baree tis cheree ||2||
lines.translation: She says, "I am the sister, and the daughter of the sister of everyone; I am the hand-maiden of one who marries me." ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੋ ਭਰਤਾ ਬਡੋ ਬਿਬੇਕੀ ਆਪੇ ਸੰਤੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hamaro bharataa bado bibekee aape sa(n)t kahaavai ||
lines.translation: My Husband is the Great One of discriminating wisdom; He alone is called a Saint.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਮਾਥੈ ਕਾਇਮੁ ਅਉਰੁ ਹਮਰੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ohu hamaarai maathai kaaim aur hamarai nikat na aavai ||3||
lines.translation: He stands by me, and no one else comes near me. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਕਹੁ ਕਾਟੀ ਕਾਨਹੁ ਕਾਟੀ ਕਾਟਿ ਕੂਟਿ ਕੈ ਡਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: naakahu kaatee kaanahu kaatee kaat koot kai daaree ||
lines.translation: I have cut off her nose, and cut off her ears, and cutting her into bits, I have expelled her.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਬੈਰਨਿ ਤੀਨਿ ਲੋਕ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: kahu kabeer sa(n)tan kee bairan teen lok kee piaaree ||4||4||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, she is the darling of the three worlds, but the enemy of the Saints. ||4||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa ||
lines.translation: Aasaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤੀ ਤਪੀ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਬਹੁ ਤੀਰਥ ਭ੍ਰਮਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jogee jatee tapee sa(n)niaasee bahu teerath bhramanaa ||
lines.translation: The Yogis, celibates, penitents and Sannyaasees make pilgrimages to all the sacred places.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੁੰਜਿਤ ਮੁੰਜਿਤ ਮੋਨਿ ਜਟਾਧਰ ਅੰਤਿ ਤਊ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: lu(n)jit mu(n)jit mon jataadhar a(n)t taoo maranaa ||1||
lines.translation: The Jains with shaven heads, the silent ones, the beggars with matted hair - in the end, they all shall die. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਸੇਵੀਅਲੇ ਰਾਮਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa te seveeale raamanaa ||
lines.translation: Meditate, therefore, on the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਿਤੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਜਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: rasanaa raam naam hit jaa kai kahaa karai jamanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: What can the Messenger of Death do to one whose tongue loves the Name of the Lord? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਗਮ ਨਿਰਗਮ ਜੋਤਿਕ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਆਕਰਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aagam niragam jotik jaanahi bahu bahu biaakaranaa ||
lines.translation: Those who know the Shaastras and the Vedas, astrology and the rules of grammar of many languages;
